notes.title: Myth of Lumi — macOS Version Now Live (Known Issue on Apple Silicon)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We’re excited to share that Myth of Lumi is now available on macOS. Thank you for your patience and support!



Important Compatibility Notice (Apple Silicon)

We’ve identified a rendering issue on some Apple Silicon (M-series) Macs where certain in-game UI elements may not display. We’re sorry for the inconvenience this may cause. Our team will be investigating and working toward a fix, and we’ll share progress through upcoming patch notes and announcements.

Affected: macOS on Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4)

Not affected: macOS on Intel chips (UI rendering should behave normally)



How You Can Help

If you encounter the issue, please let us know in the Steam Discussions with:
[olist]
Your Mac model, chip, RAM, and macOS version

Your in-game graphics settings (resolution, window mode, post-processing, etc.)

A screenshot or short video of the problem

Steps to reproduce (what you were doing when it occurred)
[/olist]


We truly appreciate your understanding and reports—they help us resolve this faster.
Enjoy your journey in Myth of Lumi!



— The Myth of Lumi Dev Team
